in_marathi.name: Nina
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dainty, Graceful, Pleasing
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nina हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nina is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Ninam', meaning 'graceful, pleasing, and dainty'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Parvati is often referred to as 'Nina', symbolizing the embodiment of feminine grace and beauty.
